prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Art direction: playful fashion editorial, exquisite detail, clean sculptural composition, luminous soft daylight, rich but restrained pastel colours, tactile materials, delightful personality. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. A tender luminous fine-art memory landscape: one small cream-coloured dog seen from behind at the bottom right of a gently curving field of tiny white daisies, gazing at an enormous soft apricot sun near the horizon. Vast pale lavender-blue sky occupies two thirds of the image, one fine wispy cloud. Dreamlike tactile painted-film texture, luminous and hopeful, quiet love and remembrance, not grief or darkness. Beautiful spare cinematographic composition. No wings, no grave, no candles, no symbols, no text. Intended final composition 1600:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
